caption:
Former Apple Watch lead Praneeta Pujari just launched UniqueHuman, an AI platform designed to help people track and manage chronic health issues like migraines. 

Building a startup is hard enough. Doing it while navigating visa rules is another level. Would you quit your stable tech job to start your own company? 👇

post.news: Former Apple Watch lead Praneeta Pujari left the company to start UniqueHuman, an AI-powered healthcare platform for chronic conditions.
